attempts.summary: Installed Apache httpd on node1 (RHEL 7.9) and configured it to serve a small inventory application on TCP port 8181 (VirtualHost + DocumentRoot /var/www/inventory) while SELinux remained in Enforcing mode throughout. Relabeled the SELinux port context for 8181 from intermapper_port_t to http_port_t via `semanage port -m`, set httpd_sys_content_t on the content directory via `semanage fcontext`/`restorecon`, and opened 8181/tcp in firewalld. Verified the service serves content locally and via NODE_IP with no AVC denials. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id/enforcing status/service state, issued `shutdown -r now`, confirmed disconnect, polled until reachable, and proved a new boot_id/boot time plus full recovery (SELinux Enforcing, httpd active and listening on 8181, inventory content served, firewall port persisted).
